info.title: Contacts
info.description:
Create, Get, update, and delete contacts. Use this API to look up contacts
by identifier, perform full or partial updates on a single contact, bulk-import
collections of contacts asynchronously, and bulk-delete contacts. When listing
contacts you can filter by contact status, list subscription status, list
membership, segment, or creation and modification date. Each contact can carry
data fields, channel properties (email, SMS, WhatsApp), list memberships,
marketing preferences, and consent records.

region.description: The Dotdigital region id your account belongs to

get.summary: Get contacts based on your criteria
get.description:
Get contacts based on criteria you specify. Contacts are returned with full data, specified data fields, or key information and identifiers only.

*Note: All data is returned in ascending order*

**Note:** This call also returns deleted contacts, with the status **deleted**. When a contact or its mobile number is deleted, **email** and **mobileNumber** are returned with the value **deleted**.

parameters.name: x-ddg-integration-token
parameters.description: If you are a partner of Dotdigital and have a [verified integration](https://developer.dotdigital.com/docs/partner-integration-verification) then include your [integration tracking token](https://developer.dotdigital.com/docs/verified-integration-tracking) here.

parameters.name: data-fields
parameters.description: Contact data is returned with a minimum of **contactId** and any associated **identifiers**. Use this field to specify any additional data fields you want to return. Enter a pipe delimited string of the contact data fields required or **[[ALL]]** to Get all data fields.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Specify additional data sets associated with the contact to include in the returned data.

parameters.name: ~created
parameters.description:
Filter by created date.
***Note:*** * The date must be in ([ISO 8601 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)) * Can't be used in conjunction with the **~modified** parameter.

parameters.name: ~modified
parameters.description:
Filter by last modified date.
***Note:*** * The date must be in ([ISO 8601 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601))

parameters.name: ~listId
parameters.description:
Filter by a specific list.
***Note:*** * Can't be used in conjunction with the **~segmentId** parameter.

parameters.name: ~segmentId
parameters.description:
Filter by a specific segment.
***Note:*** * Can't be used in conjunction with the **~listId** parameter.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to retrieve per page

parameters.name: marker
parameters.description: Pagination marker to retrieve the data from

defaultKeyDetails.summary: Get contacts with key details only
defaultKeyDetails.description:
When you do not specify **data-fields** or **include**, each contact has only its key details and identifiers. Every identifier in the account is returned for each contact. An identifier that is not set has an empty value.
**Request:** `GET /contacts/v3?limit=2`

**Note:** Timestamps are UTC and are returned without a time zone designator, with up to 3 fractional-second digits.

withDataFieldsListsAndPreferences.summary: Get contacts with selected data fields, lists and preferences
withDataFieldsListsAndPreferences.description:
Returns the **FIRSTNAME** and **LASTNAME** data fields, the lists the contact belongs to, and the marketing preferences of each contact. A data field that has no value is returned as **null**. When a contact is not in a list or has no preferences, an empty array is returned.
**Request:** `GET /contacts/v3?data-fields=FIRSTNAME|LASTNAME&include=lists|preferences&limit=2`

firstPageWithNextPage.summary: Get the first page of contacts when more pages are available
firstPageWithNextPage.description:
When more contacts are available, the response includes a **next** link. To get the next page, call the **next.link** URL, or send its **marker** value in the **marker** parameter. When there is no **next** link, you have the last page.
**Request:** `GET /contacts/v3?~modified=gte::2026-10-01T00:00:00Z&limit=2`

**Note:** The **first** and **next** links are URL-encoded. Treat the **marker** value as opaque.

modifiedSinceLastPoll.summary: Get contacts modified since your last poll
modifiedSinceLastPoll.description:
Returns the contacts that were created, updated or deleted at or after the time you specify, with their channel properties. The contacts are in ascending order of **updated**. Use this to keep another system, such as a CRM, up to date. A deleted contact has the status **deleted**, its **email** and **mobileNumber** have the value **deleted**, and its deleted channels are not included.
**Request:** `GET /contacts/v3?~modified=gte::2026-10-15T08:00:00Z&include=channelProperties&limit=1000`

**Note:** Before each poll, record the current time. On the next poll, use that time in **~modified**, not the **updated** time of the last contact you received. Get all pages until there is no **next** link.

modifiedInList.summary: Get contacts in a list that were modified since your last poll
modifiedInList.description:
Returns the contacts in list **345579** that were created or updated at or after the time you specify, with the **FIRSTNAME** and **LASTNAME** data fields.
**Request:** `GET /contacts/v3?~listId=345579&~modified=gte::2026-10-15T08:00:00Z&data-fields=FIRSTNAME|LASTNAME`

**Note:** You cannot use **~listId** and **~segmentId** in the same request.

modifiedInSegment.summary: Get contacts in a segment that were modified since your last poll
modifiedInSegment.description:
Returns the contacts in segment **12345** that were created or updated at or after the time you specify, with the **FIRSTNAME**, **LASTNAME** and **LOYALTYTIER** data fields.
**Request:** `GET /contacts/v3?~segmentId=12345&~modified=gte::2026-10-15T08:00:00Z&data-fields=FIRSTNAME|LASTNAME|LOYALTYTIER`

**Note:** You cannot use **~listId** and **~segmentId** in the same request.

post.description:
Creates a contact if the identifiers passed are unique in the account then a new contact will be created, otherwise it will fail the call with a 409.

**Note:** The request must contain **identifiers.email** or **identifiers.mobileNumber**. A contact cannot be created with only a custom identifier. If neither is sent, the call returns **400 Bad request** with the error code **contacts:identifierMissing**.

emailOnly.summary: Create a contact with an email address only
emailOnly.description: Creates a contact that has only an email address. The email channel gets the default values: **emailType** is **html**, **optInType** is **unknown**, **status** is **subscribed** and **openTracking** is **unknown**.

fullProfile.summary: Create a contact with data fields, channels, lists, preferences and consent
fullProfile.description:
Creates a contact with an email address, a mobile number and a custom identifier. The request sets data fields and email channel properties, subscribes the contact to SMS, adds the contact to a list, opts the contact into a marketing preference and adds a consent record.

**Note:** The custom identifier (`loyaltyId` in this example), the list ID and the preference ID must already exist in your account.

verifiedDoubleOptIn.summary: Create a contact that must confirm their email subscription
verifiedDoubleOptIn.description: Creates a contact with the opt-in type **verifiedDouble**. The contact is sent an email to confirm their subscription. Until the contact confirms, the email channel status is **pendingOptIn**.

smsOnly.summary: Create a contact with a mobile number only
smsOnly.description:
Creates a contact that has only a mobile number and subscribes the contact to SMS. The contact does not have an email channel.

**Note:** Send the mobile number in [E.164 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164) without the leading **+**.

mixedIdentifiers.description:
Deletes four contacts. Each item identifies one contact with one identifier: **contactId**, **email**, **mobileNumber** or a custom identifier.

**Note:** * You can send a maximum of 5000 contacts in one request. * The custom identifier (`loyaltyId` in this example) must already exist in your account. * The contacts are deleted asynchronously. Use the **deleteId** in the response to get the result with **getDeleteStatus**.

put.description:
Imports a collection of contacts. Creates contacts if they do not exist and updates contacts if they do. This is an async operation and you will need to check when it is complete by calling **getImportStatus**

**Note:** It isn't possible to specify the value for the **contactId** field when creating a contact, so it is only used to check for a matching contact when specified.

**Note:** To create a new contact, its **identifiers** must contain **email** or **mobileNumber**. A contact cannot be created with only a custom identifier. If it has only a custom identifier, it is not imported, and **getImportStatus** shows it in **failures** with the failure code **Invalid Contact**.

updateDataAndIdentifiers.summary: Update a contact's data fields and identifiers
updateDataAndIdentifiers.description:
Finds each contact by **email** and updates the data fields. The request also adds a mobile number and a custom identifier to each contact.

**Note:** The custom identifier (`loyaltyId` in this example) must already exist in your account.

unsubscribeFromEmail.summary: Unsubscribe a contact from the email channel
unsubscribeFromEmail.description: Finds the contact by **email** and sets the email channel status to **unsubscribed**. The contact's data fields, identifiers and other channels do not change.

setEmailOpenTracking.summary: Set email open tracking for a contact
setEmailOpenTracking.description: Finds each contact and sets only the **openTracking** property of the email channel. The first contact allows open tracking and the second contact does not. The email subscription status does not change.

addConsentRecord.summary: Add a consent record to a contact
addConsentRecord.description:
Finds the contact by **email** and adds a marketing consent record that was captured on a sign-up form.

**Note:** Each consent record must include **text**, **dateTimeConsented**, **url**, **ipAddress** and **userAgent**. You can send a maximum of 5 consent records for each contact.

updateDataIdentifiersAndLists.summary: Update a contact's data fields, identifiers and list membership
updateDataIdentifiersAndLists.description:
Finds each contact by the custom identifier **loyaltyId**, updates the data fields and identifiers, and adds the contact to one or more lists. If the contact does not exist, it is created.

**Note:** The custom identifier and the list IDs must already exist in your account. The contact is added to the lists you specify; it is not removed from other lists.

mixedMatchIdentifiers.summary: Import contacts that use different match identifiers
mixedMatchIdentifiers.description: Finds the first contact by **email**, the second contact by **mobileNumber** and the third contact by **contactId**. The third contact gets a new email address.

put.description:
Replaces a contact with the data passed in the request.

**Note:** * This call **replaces** the contact's **identifiers**, **dataFields**, **lists** and **preferences**. Identifiers and data fields you do not specify are removed, and the contact is removed from lists and preferences you do not specify. If you do not specify **mobileNumber**, the contact's mobile number is deleted, and **mobileNumber** then has the value **deleted**. * This call does **not** replace the email channel properties. If the contact already has an email channel, the **emailType**, **optInType**, **status** and **openTracking** properties you do not specify remain unaltered. Defaults are only applied when the contact does not have an email channel yet. * This call does **not** change consent records. The contact's existing consent records are kept. To add consent records, use **importContact** (PATCH) or **importContacts**. * To change only some fields, use the PATCH call.

replaceDataAndLists.summary: Replace a contact's identifiers, data fields, lists and preferences

Replaces the contact found by the path parameters. After the call, the contact has only the identifiers, data fields, lists and preferences in the request.

**Note:** Because this call replaces the contact, send every identifier, data field, list and preference that you want to keep. Consent records are always kept.

**Request:** `PUT /contacts/v3/email/marcus.oldacre@emailsim.io`

**Note:** Because this call replaces the contact, send every identifier, data field, list and preference that you want to keep. Consent records are always kept.

updateDataIdentifiersAndLists.description:
Finds the contact by the custom identifier **loyaltyId**, updates the data fields and identifiers, and adds the contact to two lists. If the contact does not exist, it is created.
**Request:** `PATCH /contacts/v3/loyaltyId/LOY-000912?merge-option=overwrite`

resubscribeEmail.summary: Resubscribe a contact to email with a confirmation email
resubscribeEmail.description:
Sets the email channel status to **subscribed** and sends the contact a resubscription confirmation email in English. After the contact confirms, they are sent to the URL in **redirectUrlAfterChallenge**. The data fields, identifiers, lists and preferences of the contact do not change.
**Request:** `PATCH /contacts/v3/email/priya.halvorsen@emailsim.io`

**Note:** To resubscribe the contact without a confirmation email, set **resubscribeWithNoChallenge** to **true**.

createNewContact.summary: Create a contact if it does not exist
createNewContact.description:
No contact has this email address, so a new contact is created and the call returns **201 Created**.
**Request:** `PATCH /contacts/v3/email/tobias.wrenfield@emailsim.io`

**Note:** To create a contact, the request body must contain **identifiers.email** or **identifiers.mobileNumber**, even if you use the same identifier in the path.

updateExistingContact.description:
The contact created by the **createNewContact** example exists, so it is updated and the call returns **200 OK**. Only the **LASTNAME** data field and the **openTracking** email property change.
**Request:** `PATCH /contacts/v3/email/tobias.wrenfield@emailsim.io?merge-option=overwrite`

The response to the **updateExistingContact** request example. The response contains the full contact. Lists, preferences and consent records are only included if the contact has them.

emailType.description:
Format the contact receives emails in.
* **New contacts, or contacts that do not have an email channel yet:** If not specified, this is set to **html**. * **Contacts that already have an email channel:** If not specified, the existing value remains unaltered.
***Note:** When you import a collection of contacts and one or more contacts in the collection specify **emailType**, then the contacts in the same collection that do not specify it are set to **html**. To keep the existing value, specify **emailType** for each contact, or do not specify it for any contact in the collection.*

optInType.description:
Email opt-in type for the contact.
* **New contacts, or contacts that do not have an email channel yet:** If not specified, this is set to **unknown**. * **Contacts that already have an email channel:** If not specified, the existing value remains unaltered.
***Note:** If you set this to **verifiedDouble**, or the account setting *Enforce double opt-in for all signups, including bulk uploads* is on, the contact is sent an email to confirm their subscription. Until the contact confirms, the email channel status is **pendingOptIn** and **optInType** remains **unknown**.*

status.description:
The subscription status for the email channel.
* **New contacts, or contacts that do not have an email channel yet:** If not specified, this is set to **subscribed**. * **Contacts that already have an email channel:** If not specified, the existing value remains unaltered.
***Note:** If you change the email address of an existing contact and the current email channel status is **subscribed**, **binned** or **deleted**, the status is set to **subscribed**. If the current status is **subscribed** and the account setting *Enforce double opt-in for all signups, including bulk uploads* is on, the status is set to **pendingOptIn** until the contact confirms.*

openTracking.description:
Specifies if you are allowed to track email opens for the contact.

x-ddg-notes:
This version corrects the schema and documentation for importing contacts and for email channel properties. The changes are additive; the API behaviour does not change.
* **importContacts:** Added request examples for these use cases: update data fields and identifiers, unsubscribe from email, set email open tracking, add a consent record, and update data fields, identifiers and list membership.
* **getContacts:** Added response examples: key details only, selected data fields with lists and preferences, a page with a next link, contacts modified since the last poll, and modified contacts in a list or a segment.
* **importContact:** Added request examples for the same use cases, and an example to resubscribe a contact to email. Added request examples that create and then update a contact, with their 201 and 200 response examples. The description now states that a new contact needs **identifiers.email** or **identifiers.mobileNumber** in the request body, and a 400 example shows the error.
* **deleteContacts:** Each item must now contain exactly one identifier. Items that use **email** or **mobileNumber** are now valid against the schema. Added a request example and corrected the 400 error example.
* **getImportStatus:** Added response examples, including a contact that has only a custom identifier. **matchIdentifier** is no longer required in **failures**, because the API does not return it. Replaced the failures example.
* **Contact responses:** The email, SMS and WhatsApp channel status values now match the values the API returns. A deleted channel is not included in **channelProperties**.
* **getContact:** Added examples for each identifier type in the path, and response examples for a full contact and for a contact whose mobile number was deleted.
* **replaceContact:** Added examples for each identifier type in the path, request examples to replace data and lists and to remove a mobile number, and a response example.
* **deleteContact:** Added examples for each identifier type in the path, and a response example.
* **getContact, replaceContact and deleteContact:** Corrected the 404 error examples to match the API.
* **getDeleteStatus:** Added response examples. Corrected the 404 response, which described an import request in place of a delete job.
* **createContact:** Added request examples: email address only, a full profile with channels, lists, preferences and consent, verified double opt-in, and mobile number only. Added a 201 response example. Corrected the 409 error example. The description now states that the request must contain **email** or **mobileNumber**, and a 400 example shows the error.
* **importContacts:** The description now states that a new contact needs **email** or **mobileNumber** in its identifiers, and the failure the import reports if it does not.
* **importContacts:** Contacts that match on **contactId** are now valid against the schema. The request uses the new **contactRequestIdentifiers** schema, where **contactId** is an integer.
* **Email channel properties:** **emailType**, **optInType**, **status** and **openTracking** are no longer required. The descriptions now give the default for contacts that do not have an email channel yet, and the behaviour for contacts that already have one.
* **Email channel properties:** **resubscribeOptions** can now be sent together with the other email channel properties.
* **resubscribeWithNoChallenge:** The default is now **false**, which agrees with the API behaviour.
* **Contact responses:** Email channel properties now pass validation. **emailType** and **optInType** values are now camelCase (for example **html** and **single**), which agrees with the API. **openTracking** is now included and is always returned. The request channel properties schema is no longer applied to responses, so all email and SMS statuses and the SMS **countryCode** are now valid.
* **Contact responses:** Consent records and preferences now pass validation. Preferences require **publicName** and **privateName**, which the API returns, in place of the undefined **name** property.
* **x-ddg-integration-token:** The header now uses **format: uuid** in place of a pattern that rejected every value. Send the token as a UUID without braces.
* **Contact responses:** The **created**, **updated** and consent record **dateTimeCreated** descriptions now state the formats the API returns. The **preferences** and **consentRecords** arrays can now be empty or not included.
* **Deleted contacts:** The descriptions now explain when **email** and **mobileNumber** have the value **deleted**.
* **replaceContact:** The description now states that email channel properties you do not specify remain unaltered.
